model_memory_decision.decision: 4GiB is a defensible prospective estimate for the exact already-running prebuilt normal c60 model fixture, with an additional2x reservation; not a measured complete-run upper bound.
model_memory_decision.scope: Normal prebuilt test2json/image/helpers only; serial suite -test.parallel=2; exact synthetic fixture, PG32GiB and Redis8GiB tmpfs; no compiler inside model owner.

compiler_memory_decision.decision: 2GiB prospective estimate is supportable only with a dedicated verified4GiB memory.max cgroup containing the entire compiler/tool/linker family and zero swap. Memory pressure or OOM remains a compiler failure, never qualification.
compiler_memory_decision.required_parallelism: one compiler job; GOMAXPROCS<=2 and Go -p<=2 (prefer -p=1 for first new-controller closure).
compiler_memory_decision.observed_support: Earlier final3d model compilation sampled1,776,840,704 B forest RSS; earlier root compilation1,358,991,360 B; earlier controller attempt1,506,856,960 B but COMPILE_FAIL. Sample maxima are not upper bounds.
